# QR Code generator

Vendored, unmodified C sources from Project Nayuki QR-Code-generator v1.8.0.
Source: https://github.com/nayuki/QR-Code-generator/tree/v1.8.0/c
MIT license and copyright are preserved in both source files.

The application uses the allocation-free C API through platform::ui::QRCode and QRCodeView.
